_source: JPL Horizons System / DE430 Ephemeris — J2000.0 epoch
_note: Orbital elements are mean elements, not osculating. Eccentricity and inclination vary slowly over time.

planets.name: Mars
planets.spectral_note: Thin CO₂ atmosphere; Olympus Mons, Valles Marineris

planets.name: Jupiter
planets.spectral_note: Largest planet; Great Red Spot is 350+ year old storm

planets.name: Saturn
planets.spectral_note: Ring system extends 282,000 km from center; rings ~10m thick

planets.name: Uranus
planets.spectral_note: Axial tilt 97.77° — orbits on its side; 2 ring systems

planets.name: Neptune
planets.spectral_note: Fastest winds in solar system (~2,100 km/h); Triton orbits retrograde

special_regions.name: Asteroid Belt
special_regions.note: ~1-2 million objects > 1km. Dominated by Ceres, Vesta, Pallas, Hygiea.

special_regions.name: Kuiper Belt
special_regions.note: Trans-Neptunian objects. Contains Pluto, Eris, Makemake, Haumea, Arrokoth.

special_regions.name: Scattered Disc
special_regions.note: Dynamically unstable region; source of short-period comets.

special_regions.name: Oort Cloud
special_regions.note: Hypothetical; source of long-period comets. ~0.5 ly to edge.
